name: Mira Castellane
intro: I make short films for brands: fragrance, travel, sport and the odd coffee. I like real light, long lenses and letting a shot breathe.

films.title: Wild Country
films.logline: A herd moving through Patagonian light, shot from the ground with a single long lens.

notes.title: Why I shot Wild Country on one lens
body: Every shot in Wild Country is on the same long lens. It kept us far from the horses, which kept them calm, and it flattened the land into layers.
It also made every decision simpler. When the lens can't change, you move your feet.

notes.title: Lighting black on black
body: Black silk on a black stage is mostly about where the light isn't. We used one soft source from behind and let the edges do the work.
The product only appears in the last frame. The client was nervous. It tested best of the three cuts.

notes.title: Rain you can direct
body: Real rain never turns up on the day. For Glass we built a small rain rig over a window and tuned the drop size until it read on a long lens.
Practical effects take longer to set up and less time to fix.
